evals.prompt: Write the pull request description for this branch. The repository's template is at skills/authoring-reference/evals/files/pull_request_template.md. The branch carries three commits: 'fix(reader): bound a single poll to one chunk', 'test(reader): cover the catch-up path', and 'docs(reader): record the rotation assumption'. It addresses issue #214, whose acceptance criteria are all met.
evals.expected_output: A description using only the template's three sections, summarising the branch's current state, with a closing keyword for #214.
expectations: The output's headings are exactly Summary, Dependencies, and Linked issues
No heading appears in the output that is absent from the template
The Linked issues section uses a closing keyword for issue 214 rather than a bare reference
The Summary does not narrate the order in which the work happened

evals.prompt: In skills/authoring-reference/evals/files/house_style_comments.cs, the ChunkBytes constant has no comment while the other two fields do. Add one.
evals.expected_output: A one or two line comment giving the reason for 8192, in the same shape as the neighbouring comments.
expectations: The added comment is at most two lines, like both of its neighbours
The added comment does not restate the identifier name or the literal value as prose
The added comment contains no imperative directed at the reader
No other comment in the file is modified

evals.prompt: Review the acceptance criteria in skills/authoring-reference/evals/files/issue_with_bad_criteria.md and fix any that cannot be true on the day the issue closes.
evals.expected_output: The two criteria that depend on later events are moved out of Acceptance criteria; the two checkable ones remain.
expectations: The criterion requiring a month of live operation is no longer under Acceptance criteria
The criterion depending on the admin UI follow-up is no longer under Acceptance criteria
Both relocated items appear under a Deliverables heading or an explicitly named follow-up
The two criteria about reading configuration and the 30-minute fallback remain under Acceptance criteria

evals.prompt: Write the commit message for the change in skills/authoring-reference/evals/files/staged_change.diff.
evals.expected_output: A conventional-commit subject plus a body stating why the bound exists and what it costs, with no file list.
expectations: The subject line follows the type(scope): subject form and carries no trailing period
The body states why the change exists rather than what the diff shows
The body names a cost, limit, or trade the change accepts
The body contains no list of changed file paths
The body contains no date, build number, or pipeline number

evals.prompt: Review the comments in skills/authoring-reference/evals/files/comments_to_review.cs. Remove any comment that adds nothing, and add one where a reader would need it.
evals.expected_output: The loop paraphrase is deleted and the regular expression gains a comment saying what it matches.
expectations: The comment that paraphrases the loop is removed
A comment is added to the Timestamped regular expression
The added comment states what the pattern matches, including that it excludes lines whose text begins with a bracket
No comment is added that restates a method or field name

evals.expected_output: A page holding one mode, leading with the install and init commands, with the history and architecture prose moved out.
expectations: The first instruction a reader can act on appears before any historical or architectural prose
The 2019 origin story is not present on the page
The output names where the removed background belongs rather than only deleting it
The install and init commands are both still present and unchanged
